body: the black umbrella bears a treated-seed stain and the camera a closure mark. one rope knot holds both objects together.
title: Black umbrella with the second residue

body: A clear ring dries across the notebook's crop-row drawing. The bottle cap is clean; the page beneath it is stained only where the drawn rows meet.
title: The bottle's ring crosses a row sketch

body:
“Track access ends at the barrier. Keep the west lane clear for the last vehicle.” The receiving line is blank; on the back, someone asks for a green scarf to be saved.

The person who handed this to me asked me to keep the date. I did, though the next version left that day out entirely.

The next morning I looked for a second copy and found only the envelope. I left this one unfolded for whoever came after us.
title: Dispatch copy with an unfinished return

body:
The note lists three crop rows and a water check, then continues onto the cover. “Bring the small boots home” is written below the last line.

I carried it home because there was nowhere open to return it. The mark did not come off when I tried to wash my hands.

The next morning I looked for a second copy and found only the envelope. I left this one unfolded for whoever came after us.
title: The row count continues past the page
